newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala newborn rescued from pit toilet.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala newborn rescued from pit toilet.

text.p: Rescue workers saved the life of a baby who was accidentally born in a pit toilet on Tuesday morning, La Hora newspaper reported.

According to the report, 26-year-old Nelvia Diaz knew she was in labour but did not realise how close she was to giving birth when she went to the bathroom and sat on the toilet, only to feel the baby girl slide out and fall into the pit beneath her.
Firemen used tubes to supply oxygen to the baby while they spent four hours tearing down the outhouse and digging in from the sides to rescue her from the human waste pit.
The baby and the mother were in good condition on Tuesday afternoon under observation in a local hospital, the newspaper said.
